articles.title: Judge orders OpenAI to turn over hiring records in Apple trade secrets case
articles.description: A federal judge ruled that Apple can access OpenAI's interview materials involving former Apple employees, as well as private messages and testimony from key figures in the case.

articles.title: Trezor reduces resellers as a ‘preventative step’ amid Ledger tampering reports

articles.title: Facebook is giving users more control over their algorithm

articles.title: Laplace Intelligence red-teams robots and self-driving cars before they hit the real world
articles.description: University of Michigan spinout Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving vehicles before deployment. The profitable startup is competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt, October 13-15 in San Francisco.

articles.title: Pluto Security raises $42M as AI gives enterprise security teams a new headache
articles.description: The problem with giving everyone in a company access to AI tools is that people will use them in unexpected ways. And that fact is steadily seeding fears that companies now have new, gaping security holes in their systems or, at least, will soon.

articles.title: MIT startup says it can turn diesel trucks into cheaper hydrogen haulers — see it at Disrupt
articles.description: Diesel is expensive and polluting, and LNK Energies says it has come up with a way to replace it with hydrogen, all while undercutting diesel on cost.

articles.title: Google Play now lets anyone build private, vibe-coded apps that run on Android

articles.title: How the SEC’s lack of leadership could facilitate crypto rulemaking
